_note: The two graders agreed on all 17 items and the assertion (agreement-U4.json), so there was nothing to settle; the consensus is their agreed mapping, with grader A's reasons.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply groups problems under 'Fix before launch' (items 1-5), 'Fix next' and 'Smaller issues', most severe first. It also names what it could not check: 'Not tested: real VoiceOver and TalkBack.' and a 'Check with the agency (my inference, not something I could confirm)' section.

mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking; no busy state; done page still headed 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Book shows nothing for 1.5 s, a second tap saves the booking as cancelled, and the page is still titled 'Booked'. This is exactly D09.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold runs out unseen; slot becomes a dash with 'no longer available' and no way back
mapping.reason: The hold is never shown, and when it lapses the slot line turns to '—' with 'This slot is no longer available.' This is the D08 harm.

mapping.title: Today's past or imminent slots shown as free, refused only at the last step
mapping.reason: Slots that have passed or start within 30 minutes can be chosen, and the refusal comes on the final step after the details are typed. This matches D06.

mapping.title: Van/trailer permit not checked on vehicle step; fails at the end with no link back to the field
mapping.reason: It covers the permit field's behaviour, Next accepting an empty permit, and the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' error with no route back. The instructions put all of these under D07.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the screen at 320/360 px; page scrolls sideways, right column cut off
mapping.reason: A script sizes the grid columns without the page margins, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. This is D04.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots jump to the top of the grid, out of time order and reading/focus order
mapping.reason: The order:-1 style moves 'Few left' slots ahead of the Morning heading, so the screen order and the keyboard/screen-reader order differ. This is D10.

mapping.title: Slot buttons show no keyboard focus
mapping.reason: An injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' hides the focus ring on every slot button. This is D05.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag contrast below 4.5:1 in light and dark themes
mapping.reason: It reports 3.0:1 light and 3.4:1 dark against the 4.5:1 requirement for the 'Few left' tag. This is D03.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on Today
mapping.reason: Going back from the check step opens on 'Today' with nothing selected, while the vehicle and details are kept. This is D12.

mapping.title: Confirmation page shows only the reference, not day, slot or vehicle
mapping.reason: The 'Booked' page lacks the day, time and vehicle that residents need to check at the gate. This is D14.

mapping.title: No loading message while slots arrive; Next does nothing meanwhile
mapping.reason: Slots take about a second, nothing shows in the meantime, and tapping Next does nothing. This is the wait itself, D01.

mapping.title: 'Another day' date field asks for DD/MM/YYYY but iPhone numeric keypad has no '/'
mapping.reason: Residents book mostly on phones. A required format they cannot type on the keypad offered, with no hint that digits alone work, can block or confuse them when picking a day beyond the preset buttons. This is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Slot length / arrive-within-slot only in a tooltip phones never show
mapping.reason: The slot length and 'Arrive within your slot' are only in a hover tooltip, which never appears on a phone. This is D13.

mapping.title: Mobile number required though only used for a reminder
mapping.reason: Making a reminder-only field mandatory stops residents without a mobile phone from booking at all, so it locks them out of the service. It is not seeded.

mapping.title: First slot count not announced to screen readers
mapping.reason: aria-live is applied only after the first update, so screen readers miss the day's slot count. This is D11.

mapping.title: 'Today' fixed to 12 October 2026 and day buttons hard-coded
mapping.reason: This is about the review build's stubbed date, which the review itself calls an inference and possibly a demo stub. It is not a usability problem residents meet in the flow as built.

mapping.title: Slots and bookings look like placeholders; no server request
mapping.reason: This is a back-end/demo-stub concern the review flags as unconfirmed inference. It describes no interface harm to residents using the flow.
